read.en: Zscaler fell 3.0% on Nov 17 to $185.19, trading $180.78–192.82. It slipped just below the 100-day ($186.0, rising) and stays above the 200-day ($166.5); it is below the 5-day ($191.1), 10-day ($197.5) and 30-day ($220.2), all falling. MACD has been below its signal since Nov 2, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($216.84), and RSI is 32.2.
read.zh: Zscaler 11月17日下跌 3.0%，收于 $185.19，盘中区间 $180.78–192.82。股价跌至 100 日均线（$186.0，上行）略下方，仍位于 200 日均线（$166.5）上方；低于 5 日（$191.1）、10 日（$197.5）和 30 日均线（$220.2），三者均在下行。MACD 自 11月2日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$216.84），RSI 为 32.2。

read.en: The close broke the $186.5–188.9 support band (Sep 28, Nov 10 and Nov 16 lows) and the 100-day, now resistance; the $180.78 low undercut the Nov 12 low ($184.63). Resistance is $186–188.9, then $190.8–194.4 (Nov 16 close, 5-day, Nov 12 high) and $195.8–197.5 (Nov 9 low, Nov 13 high, 10-day). Support is $180.8–184.6, then $175 and $166.5 (200-day). A close above $188.9 would target $191–194; below $180.8, $175.

r.en: 100-day average $186.0; Nov 16 low $186.51; Sep 28 low $187.67; Nov 10 low $188.88, lost
